title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu is thrilled when a nurse confirms Kanmani's pregnancy after the fire accident. His joy turns to surprise when Thenmozhi reveals she already knew.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman asks Kumaresan not to drop the case to find Ashok's killer, then finds witness Aiyappan dead. Later, he names the child Anand, shocking Kalamma, as it's his real name.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri celebrates Diya's birthday with special decorations and a homemade cake. Shanmugam firmly reminds Vetri that his actions cannot erase his deception towards Abinaya.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi schemes to have Poongod's food reach the family through Pennycuick, who brings it home as Prasadham. Devastated, Azhagar confides in Meenatchi and questions the setup.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan erupts over Malar's diet food when Revathi visits to check on Lakshmi's health. Seeing Lakshmi support Malar and Mathi, Revathi is pleased by her changed behaviour.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Thangamayil's emotional arrival at Saravanan's home leaves everyone stunned. Haunted by her past deception, she regrets staying despite the family's unwavering support.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Karthika's revelation about her past love with Cheran enrages Chandayatha's family. Meanwhile, her furious father confronts Cheran and vows to stop their marriage.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: The court declares Manoj the father of Rohini's child, prompting her to demand her rights. Vijaya refuses to let her enter until Muthu warns her of the legal consequences.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: At Tamizhselvi's kid's ear piercing, Sethupathi learns the car was mortgaged for funds. Later, Chithra and Eshwari rejoice at her plight, then grow confused by Rajangam's call.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu panics when she and Arjun get trapped in an elevator, while Arjun enjoys the unexpected situation. Aadhavan admires Pooja as she enjoys ice cream at the restaurant.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Sarasu tearfully thanks Indhira for her unwavering support. Touched by their deep bond, Lakshmi grows to admire Indhira.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 2: The Power Cards are Here!
description: As kitchen team does the luxury budget shopping, Avinash manages to win the Asura Pasi task. Amidst the arguments and chaos, BB announces some special power cards.
